setup.title: Set up Streamero
setup.intro: Welcome! Create the administrator account for this server.
setup.codeHint: The server prints it to its log on start, e.g. docker compose logs streamero | grep setup_code.

home.settingsText: Manage your account, signed-in devices and — as an administrator — users and the server.
home.noLibraries: No libraries yet. Ask an administrator to add one.
home.noLibrariesAdmin: Add a library with your movies or shows to start.

account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
account.displayNameHint: Shown in the menu and to administrators instead of the username.
account.emailHint: Optional. For notifications and password help from an administrator.
account.languageHint: Used on every device you sign in on.

devices.intro: Devices signed in to your account. Signing a device out takes effect immediately.
devices.introAdmin: Devices signed in to this server, for all users. Signing a device out takes effect immediately.
devices.name: Device name
devices.confirmSignOut: Sign out “{{name}}”? It will have to sign in again.

users.confirmDelete: Delete user {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
users.confirmReset2fa: Turn off two-factor authentication for {{name}} (e.g. lost phone)? They will be signed out everywhere.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.account_locked: Too many failed sign-ins. The account is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.setup_completed: This server is already set up. Please sign in.
errors.invalid_setup_code: The setup code is not correct.
errors.setup_throttled: Too many wrong setup codes. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalid_username: Usernames may contain letters, digits, spaces and . _ - @
errors.invalid_request: Please check the entered values (passwords need at least 8 characters).
errors.last_admin: The last administrator cannot be removed, demoted or disabled.
errors.self: You cannot delete or disable your own account.
errors.not_found: Not found — it may have been removed already.
errors.session_required: This action is not available with an API key.
errors.totp_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
errors.invalid_totp: The code is not correct or was already used.
errors.profile_locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.kid_profile: Not available in a kids profile.
errors.too_many_profiles: An account can have at most 6 profiles.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts from your network. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.invalid_path: That folder does not exist or is outside the media folders.
errors.unsupported_kind: Music libraries arrive in a later phase.
errors.invalid_tmdb_key: TMDb rejected this key. Copy it again from themoviedb.org/settings/api.
errors.tmdb_unreachable: TMDb could not be reached from the server. Try again later.
errors.transcode_not_allowed: This file needs transcoding, which your account is not allowed to use.
errors.transcode_failed: The server could not prepare this file for playback.
errors.transcoder_busy: The server is converting too many streams right now. Stop playback on another device or try again in a minute.
errors.request_too_large: That is too large to send to the server.
errors.not_playable: This item has no playable file.
errors.invalid_notification_target: Check the service and URL (http or https; Gotify needs an app token).
errors.notification_failed: The target did not accept the message. Check the URL and token.
errors.tmdb_not_configured: Add a TMDb key in Settings → Metadata first.
errors.metadata_locked: This title was edited by hand. Use Identify to replace it from TMDb.
errors.invalid_email: That e-mail address is not valid.
errors.invalid_image: That file is not a JPEG, PNG or GIF picture.
errors.image_too_large: The picture is larger than 8 MB.
errors.invalid_url: That address is not valid (use http:// or https://).
errors.upstream_failed: The other app did not answer or rejected the request.
errors.not_configured: This connection is not set up.
errors.not_in_arr: Radarr or Sonarr does not manage this title, so Bazarr cannot find it.
errors.backup_newer_schema: This backup was made by a newer Streamero version. Update the server first.
errors.invalid_backup: The file is not a readable Streamero backup.
errors.backup_busy: Another backup or restore is running. Try again in a moment.
errors.backup_confirm_mismatch: Type the backup name exactly to confirm.
errors.import_key_rejected: The other server rejected the API key. Create one under Dashboard → API Keys there.
errors.import_source_failed: The other server could not be reached or gave an unexpected answer. Check the address.
errors.import_running: An import is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.password_login_disabled: Password sign-in is turned off. Use single sign-on or Quick Connect.
errors.no_local_password: This account signs in through single sign-on or LDAP and has no Streamero password.
errors.no_account: No Streamero account is linked to this sign-in.
errors.not_allowed: This account is not allowed to sign in here.
errors.identity_taken: That account is already linked to another Streamero user.
errors.already_linked: An account from this provider is already linked.
errors.last_sign_in_method: This is the only way this account can sign in, so it cannot be unlinked.
errors.no_sso_admin: Link an administrator to single sign-on or LDAP first, or you could lock everyone out.
errors.invalid_state: The sign-in expired or was already used. Try again.
errors.provider_error: The identity provider refused the sign-in.
errors.provider_unreachable: The provider could not be reached or answered incorrectly.
errors.tuners_busy: Every tuner is in use right now. Try again when a recording or another viewer finishes.
errors.channel_unavailable: The channel can't be tuned right now.
errors.file_missing: This file is no longer where the server expected it. The library is being rescanned; try again in a minute.

apikeys.intro: API keys let integrations such as Jellyseerr, Radarr or your own scripts use Streamero. A key has the rights of the administrator who created it and stops working if that account is disabled or loses admin rights.
apikeys.name: Name
apikeys.copyNow: Copy the key now — it will not be shown again.
apikeys.confirmRevoke: Revoke API key {{name}}? Integrations using it stop working immediately.

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.intro: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden…) in addition to your password.
twofa.step1: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or on this phone tap the link. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twofa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twofa.enabledText: Sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app. To turn it off, confirm your password.
twofa.recoveryText: Each code can be used once instead of an app code, e.g. if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again. Other devices were signed out.
twofa.loginHint: 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

quickconnect.loginIntro: On a device where you are already signed in, open Settings → Quick Connect and enter this code:
quickconnect.waiting: Waiting for approval… (the code is valid for 5 minutes)
quickconnect.settingsIntro: Enter the 6-digit code shown on a new device (TV, phone, another browser) to sign it in with your account.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.note: Administrators can always do everything. Each permission takes effect as its feature arrives (libraries, playback, Live TV).
permissions.maxSessionsHint: 0 = unlimited. Signing in on one more device signs out the least recently used one.

invites.intro: Whoever opens the link can create an ordinary (non-admin) account with default permissions until it expires or runs out of uses.
invites.copyNow: Share this link now — it will not be shown again.
invites.invalidText: This invite link has expired, was used up or was revoked. Ask for a new one.
invites.joinIntro: You were invited. Choose a username and password for your account.
invites.confirmRevoke: Revoke the invite “{{name}}”? The link stops working immediately.

profiles.intro: Profiles let several people share this account (up to 6). A kids profile cannot open settings; leaving it needs the account password.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.pinHint: 4–6 digits. Leave empty to keep the current PIN.

libraries.intro: Libraries point at folders on the server. Streamero only reads them; nothing in these folders is ever changed or deleted.
libraries.name: Name
libraries.foldersHint: The folder set as MEDIA_PATH in the server's .env appears here as /media. One movie per folder, e.g. "Movies/Dune (2021)/Dune (2021).mkv"; shows as "Shows/Name (Year)/Season 01/Name S01E01.mkv".
libraries.confirmDelete: Remove library {{name}} from Streamero? The files stay untouched.
libraries.held_one: {{count}} missing file was kept: a library folder looks offline or mostly empty. If you deleted it on purpose, remove it from the library.
libraries.held_few: {{count}} missing files were kept: a library folder looks offline or mostly empty. If you deleted them on purpose, remove them from the library.
libraries.held_other: {{count}} missing files were kept: a library folder looks offline or mostly empty. If you deleted them on purpose, remove them from the library.
libraries.confirmRemoveMissing: Remove {{count}} missing files from {{name}}? Watch history of those titles is lost. Files on disk are not touched.

library.empty: Nothing here yet. Check the folder layout or scan again.
library.noMetadata: No match on TMDb yet — check the folder name (e.g. "Title (Year)" or add [tmdbid-…]).
library.myListEmpty: Titles you add to My list appear here.
library.noGenres: No genres yet. They appear once titles have metadata.

metadata.intro: Posters, descriptions, cast and age ratings come from TMDb (The Movie Database). Enter your free TMDb API key; new items get metadata automatically after each scan.
metadata.key: TMDb API key or Read Access Token
metadata.replaceKey: New TMDb key (leave empty to keep the current one)
metadata.saved: Saved. Metadata is being fetched for your libraries.
metadata.confirmRemove: Remove the TMDb key? Existing metadata stays.
metadata.step2: Request an API key (type “Developer”, any app name) at
metadata.step3: Copy the “API Read Access Token” (or the API key) and paste it below.
metadata.step4: Save: titles, descriptions, cast with photos, posters, logos and collections are fetched for every library.
metadata.nudgeText: Add a free TMDb key to get proper titles, descriptions, cast photos, posters and logos.

player.fallback: This browser couldn't play the file directly, so it is being converted.
player.playbackFailed: This video can't be played in this browser right now.

search.title: Search
search.none: Nothing found. Try another spelling or an actor's name.
search.start: Type a title, a year or an actor.

integrations.seerrIntro: In Seerr/Jellyseerr choose "Jellyfin" as the media server and enter:
integrations.seerrAccount: Sign in with a Streamero administrator account without two-factor sign-in, then sync and enable the libraries and run the full scan. Matching uses TMDb IDs, so set up Settings → Metadata first.
integrations.arrIntro: In Settings → Connect add "Emby / Jellyfin" with these values, turn "Send Notifications" off and "Update Library" on:
integrations.arrKey: API key: create one for each app under
integrations.bazarr: Nothing to set up: subtitles that Bazarr saves next to the video appear in Streamero automatically within about 15 seconds.

tasks.title: Scheduled tasks
tasks.intro: Maintenance the server runs on its own. Run one now if you just changed folders or the TMDb key.
tasks.scan_all_hint: Finds new, changed and removed files
tasks.refresh_metadata_hint: Fetches posters, descriptions and cast for items that have none, and video frames where TMDb has no art
tasks.cleanup_images_hint: Removes cached images of deleted titles
tasks.analyze_media_hint: Chapters and skippable parts named by them, seek-bar thumbnails
tasks.detect_segments_hint: Compares the audio of each season's episodes to find the shared intro and end credits (black frames when the audio has none); only new or changed episodes
tasks.backup_hint: Database and settings into the backup folder; old backups are removed by the retention setting
tasks.refresh_guide_hint: Reloads XMLTV guides and channel lists, and schedules series recordings

backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: A backup holds the whole database (users, libraries, watch history, settings) and the config folder. Media files are never included.
backups.scanWarning: A library scan is running. The backup stays consistent, but titles still being added may be missing from it.
backups.deleteConfirm: Delete this backup file? This cannot be undone.
backups.restoreWarning: Everything in the database is replaced with this backup: users, libraries, watch history and settings made after it are lost. A safety backup of the current state is written first, then the server restarts.
backups.restore_running: Restoring {{name}}… The server restarts when it is done.
backups.safetyBackup: The state before the restore is kept as {{name}}.
backups.uploadHint: A .tar.gz from another Streamero server. It is checked and stored here, not restored yet.
backups.enabledHint: The worker writes one backup a day.
backups.keepLastHint: How many scheduled and manual backups to keep. Uploaded and pre-restore backups are only deleted by hand.
backups.includeImagesHint: Downloaded posters and backdrops can be fetched again, so they are left out by default. Including them makes backups much larger.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Send server events to Discord, ntfy, Gotify or any webhook: new titles, who started watching, sign-ins.
notifications.name: Name
notifications.help_discord: Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy URL.
notifications.help_ntfy: The full topic URL; add an access token for protected topics.
notifications.help_gotify: Server address; the app token comes from Gotify → Apps.
notifications.help_generic: Receives a JSON POST: event, title, message, data, server.

playbackPrefs.title: Playback
playbackPrefs.intro: Applies to this profile on every device.
playbackPrefs.mode_default_hint: Forced subtitles in the audio language; otherwise your subtitle language when the audio is in another language.
playbackPrefs.mode_smart_hint: Only when the audio is not in your subtitle language.
playbackPrefs.mode_always_hint: Always show your subtitle language when available.
playbackPrefs.mode_none_hint: No subtitles unless you turn them on.
playbackPrefs.audioHint: Picked when a file has several audio tracks.
playbackPrefs.subtitlesHint: Used together with the subtitle mode below.
playbackPrefs.skipIntroHint: Detected from chapters and from the theme shared between episodes.
playbackPrefs.skipCreditsHint: When credits start and there is a next episode.
playbackPrefs.autoplayHint: At the end of an episode or during its credits.
playbackPrefs.upNextHint: With no countdown the card waits for you.
playbackPrefs.qualityIntro: Limits for this profile, for slow connections or data plans. Titles above a limit are converted on the server.
playbackPrefs.maxBitrateHint: Includes audio. Direct play is used whenever a file is under the limit.

collections.title: Collections
collections.empty: No collections yet. Movie series (box sets) appear here once metadata is fetched; administrators can also make their own from a title's page.
collections.confirmDelete: Delete the collection {{name}}? The titles stay in your library.

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.name: Playlist name
playlists.addHint: Add titles from their page with the list button.
playlists.shareAll: Visible to everyone on this server

metadataEdit.title: Edit metadata
metadataEdit.name: Title
metadataEdit.lockHint: Metadata refreshes will not overwrite this title.

subtitleLook.title: Subtitle appearance
subtitleLook.sample: This is how subtitles will look.
subtitleLook.positionHint: Useful on TVs that crop the edge of the picture.

homePrefs.title: Home screen
homePrefs.intro: Choose the rows on the home page and their order. Changes apply to this profile.

transcoding.title: Transcoding
transcoding.intro: Used when a device cannot play a file as it is. Direct play and remuxing never re-encode.
transcoding.hardware_none_hint: Works everywhere; uses the most processor time.
transcoding.presetHint: Faster settings use less processor time and give larger files.
transcoding.qualityHint: Lower numbers look better and need more bandwidth. 20–23 suits most screens.
transcoding.segmentHint: Shorter segments start and seek faster; longer ones are more efficient.
transcoding.maxSessionsHint: Further viewers get an error instead of slowing everyone down.
transcoding.toneMappingHint: Convert HDR colours for screens without HDR when transcoding.

resume.title: Resume
resume.intro: When a stopped title keeps its position and when it counts as watched.
resume.minHint: Stopping earlier does not save a position.
resume.maxHint: From here on the title is marked watched.
resume.durationHint: Shorter titles never keep a position.

activityLog.title: Activity
activityLog.intro: Sign-ins, account changes and settings changes, newest first.

branding.title: Branding
branding.disclaimerHint: For example who the server is for, or whom to ask for an account.
branding.cssHint: Added to every page of the web client. Design tokens like --amb-a or --color-bg can be overridden here.

discover.title: Discover
discover.intro: Find any movie or series. If it is not here yet, request it and it downloads automatically through Seerr, Radarr and Sonarr.
discover.notConfigured: Requests are not set up on this server yet.

requests.keyStored: A key is stored. Enter a new one to replace it.
requests.seerrIntro: Seerr or Jellyseerr searches TMDb and passes requests to Radarr and Sonarr. Streamero only needs its address and API key.
requests.usersCanRequestHint: Off: only administrators can request. Kids profiles never can.
requests.arrIntro: Optional. Used for the “Coming soon” calendar on the Discover page.
requests.bazarrIntro: Optional. Finds and downloads subtitles from the title page. Bazarr looks titles up through Radarr and Sonarr, so connect those too.

enhancements.title: Enhancements
enhancements.intro: Features other media servers need plugins for are built into Streamero. Switch off what you do not want; nothing third-party runs inside the server, so updates never break them.
enhancements.qualityTags_hint: 4K, HD, HDR and Dolby Vision labels.
enhancements.randomButton_hint: A button on home and in libraries that opens a random unwatched title.
enhancements.pauseScreen_hint: Title, year and story on screen after a few seconds of pause.
enhancements.autoPip_hint: Playback continues in a small window while you do something else.
enhancements.discoverInSearch_hint: Search also shows titles that are not here yet, ready to request (needs Seerr).
enhancements.arrLinks_hint: Administrators see where a title is managed (needs Radarr/Sonarr in Requests).

music.empty: No music here yet. Put albums in Artist/Album folders and scan again.

subs.searching: Asking the subtitle providers… this can take a minute.
subs.notConfigured: Subtitle search uses Bazarr, and Bazarr finds titles through Radarr and Sonarr.
subs.autoStarted: Bazarr is searching. New subtitles appear after the next scan.
subs.downloaded: Downloaded. The subtitle appears in a few seconds.

import.title: Import from another media server
import.intro: Bring over what each person watched, where they stopped, their favourites and playlists before you switch the old server off. Media files are not copied or changed.
import.urlHint: As Streamero's server reaches it, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096
import.apiKeyHint: Create one on the old server under Dashboard → API Keys. It is used only for this import and never shown again.
import.usersHint: Choose who receives each person's history. Same usernames are matched automatically; the data goes to the main profile.
import.pathsHint: Titles are matched by TMDb, IMDb and TVDB ids first, then by file path, then by title and year. If the old server saw your media under a different folder, add the mapping here.
import.playlistsHint: Recreate playlists for their owners, in the same order.
import.safeAgain: Safe to run again: nothing is duplicated and newer Streamero progress is kept.
import.dryRunNote: Dry run: nothing was saved. This is what an import would bring over.
import.matchedSummary: Matched {{provider}} by id, {{path}} by file path and {{title}} by title. Not found: {{unmatched}}.
import.playlistSummary: Playlists created: {{created}}, updated: {{updated}}. Entries not found: {{missing}}.
import.keptNewer: Titles where newer Streamero progress was kept: {{count}}.
import.unmatchedHint: Usually titles that are not in a Streamero library, or a folder mapping is missing. Showing up to 50.

dlna.title: DLNA for TVs
dlna.intro: Smart TVs on your home network (LG, Samsung, Sony …) can browse and play the library from their built-in media player, without an app. TVs cannot sign in, so DLNA acts as the user chosen here.
dlna.enabled: Share with TVs on this network
dlna.enabledHint: Anyone on the local network can browse what this user may see. Off until you turn it on.
dlna.friendlyNameHint: Leave empty to use the server name.
dlna.userHint: Libraries, parental limits and resume positions of this user apply.
dlna.status_unavailable: DLNA is turned off for this server (STREAMERO_DLNA=false).
dlna.noDiscovery: TVs find the server on their own only with host networking or a macvlan network; see the DLNA section of the integrations guide.
dlna.needUser: Choose a user before turning DLNA on.

sso.title: Sign-in
sso.intro: Let people sign in with your identity provider (OpenID Connect) or directory (LDAP / Active Directory).
sso.publicUrlHint: The address people open Streamero at. Single sign-on redirects back here, so it must match exactly.
sso.disablePasswordHint: Only single sign-on and LDAP accounts can sign in. Needs an administrator who can already sign in that way.
sso.recoveryActive: Recovery mode is on (STREAMERO_PASSWORD_LOGIN_RECOVERY): administrators can sign in with a password. Remove it once you are back in.
sso.oidcIntro: Works with Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia, Microsoft Entra ID, Google and any provider with OpenID Connect discovery.
sso.needsPublicUrl: Set the public address above to get the redirect URI.
sso.confirmDelete: Remove {{name}}? Accounts linked through it will no longer be able to use it.
sso.label: Button label
sso.labelHint: Shown as “Continue with …” on the sign-in page.
sso.idHint: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Part of the redirect URI; cannot be changed later.
sso.secretHint: Stored on the server and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the current one.
sso.scopesHint: Separated by spaces; openid is always included.
sso.groupsClaimHint: A dotted path works too, e.g. realm_access.roles.
sso.adminGroupHint: Members become administrators; others lose admin rights. Empty: managed in Streamero.
sso.allowedGroupHint: Only members may sign in. Empty: everyone the provider signs in.
sso.autoCreateHint: A first sign-in creates a Streamero user. Otherwise only linked users can sign in.
sso.linkByEmailHint: An existing user with the same e-mail address is linked on first sign-in, if the provider says the address is verified.
sso.trustEmailHint: For providers that do not send email_verified (e.g. Microsoft). Only for a provider you control.
sso.testOk: The provider answered correctly ({{keys}} signing keys).
sso.testNoPkce: It does not advertise PKCE (S256); Streamero sends it anyway.
sso.ldapIntro: Directory users sign in with their username and password in the normal fields, on the web, in the apps and in third-party apps. Their password is never stored.
sso.ldapEnabledHint: Usernames that are not Streamero accounts are looked up in the directory; an account is created on first sign-in.
sso.startTlsHint: Encrypt ldap:// connections. Not needed for ldaps://.
sso.skipVerifyHint: Unsafe: anyone on the network could read passwords. For testing only.
sso.plainWarning: Without StartTLS or ldaps:// passwords travel unencrypted.
sso.usernameAttrHint: uid, or sAMAccountName for Active Directory.
sso.groupFilterHint: Search groups instead of reading memberOf, e.g. (&(objectClass=groupOfNames)(member={dn})).
sso.ldapAdminGroupHint: Group DN whose members are administrators. Empty: managed in Streamero.
sso.ldapAllowedGroupHint: Group DN required to sign in. Empty: anyone the filter finds.
sso.ldapTestOk: Connected and signed in with the service account.
sso.linkedIntro: Accounts you can use to sign in to Streamero.

error.invalid_state: The sign-in expired or was already used. Try again.
error.provider_error: The identity provider refused the sign-in.
error.no_account: No Streamero account is linked to this sign-in. Ask an administrator.
error.not_allowed: Your account is not allowed to sign in here.
error.identity_taken: That account is already linked to another Streamero user.
error.already_linked: An account from this provider is already linked.
error.unknown_provider: This sign-in option no longer exists.
error.not_configured: Single sign-on is not set up completely. Ask an administrator.

together.title: Watch together
together.intro: Start a watch party for this title and send the link: everyone plays, pauses and seeks together.
together.gone: This watch party has ended, or you can't open what it is playing.
together.notAllowed: Watching together is turned off for this account.

action.next: {{name}} moved on to the next title

errors.forbidden: Someone in the watch party can't open this title.
errors.rate_limited: Too many actions at once — wait a moment.
errors.too_many_groups: The server has too many watch parties right now.
errors.not_in_group: You are no longer in the watch party.
errors.invalid_request: That can't be done right now.
errors.invalid: That can't be done right now.

downloads.originalHint: Save the file exactly as it is on the server
downloads.adminIntro: The apps can download titles for offline viewing, either the original file or a smaller MP4 the server converts in the background. Converted files are kept in a cache on the server until the apps have fetched them.
downloads.maxTranscodesHint: More downloads wait in the queue. Each conversion uses the CPU or GPU like a stream would.
downloads.cacheLimitHint: In use: {{used}}. Over the limit, the files fetched longest ago are deleted first.
downloads.keepDaysHint: A converted file nobody fetched for this long is deleted.
downloads.noTranscodes: Nothing is being converted for download.

livetv.title: Live TV
livetv.noPermission: Your account can't watch Live TV. Ask an administrator.
livetv.emptyAdmin: No channels yet. Add a tuner and a guide in Settings → Live TV.
livetv.noFavorites: No favourite channels yet. Mark some with the heart.
livetv.conflictNotice: No tuner is free at that time. It will record if one becomes free or if you raise its priority.
livetv.recordingsIntro: Finished recordings also appear in the Recordings library, with details from the guide.
livetv.conflicts_one: {{count}} recording can't get a tuner. Change priorities or cancel something.
livetv.conflicts_few: {{count}} recordings can't get a tuner. Change priorities or cancel something.
livetv.conflicts_other: {{count}} recordings can't get a tuner. Change priorities or cancel something.
livetv.priorityHint: When tuners run out, higher priority records first.
livetv.seriesIntro: A series rule records every airing of a title the guide lists, now and later.
livetv.noRules: No series rules yet. Open a programme in the guide and choose Record series.
livetv.seriesTitleHint: As the guide writes it (not case-sensitive).
livetv.keepLastHint: When clean-up is on: 0 = server default.
livetv.deleteRuleConfirm: Delete the rule for “{{title}}” and its upcoming recordings? Finished recordings stay.
livetv.timeshiftInfo: Pause and rewind up to {{minutes}} min

livetvAdmin.tunersIntro: Where channels come from: an M3U playlist from your provider, or an HDHomeRun on your network. The tuner count limits how many channels play or record at once.
livetvAdmin.name: Name
livetvAdmin.fileHint: A path the server can read, inside the media folders or /config/livetv.
livetvAdmin.deviceAddressHint: IP address or URL of the HDHomeRun, e.g. http://192.168.1.50
livetvAdmin.tunerCountM3u: Streams your provider allows at once (0 = unlimited).
livetvAdmin.tunerCountHdhr: Empty = as many as the device has.
livetvAdmin.userAgentHint: Only if your provider asks for a specific one.
livetvAdmin.discoverNone: No HDHomeRun found. With Docker bridge networking the search can't see the LAN: add the device by its address.
livetvAdmin.deleteTunerConfirm: Remove “{{name}}” and its channels? Scheduled recordings on them are cancelled.
livetvAdmin.guidesIntro: Programme listings in XMLTV format. Refreshed on a schedule; unchanged programmes are skipped.
livetvAdmin.timezoneHint: Only for times without an offset. Empty = UTC.
livetvAdmin.mappingIntro: Channels are matched to the guide by id, then by name. Pick a guide channel by hand where that fails.
livetvAdmin.noChannels: No channels yet. Add a tuner first.
livetvAdmin.recordingsPathHint: Set with STREAMERO_RECORDINGS_DIR. Recordings appear in a Recordings library.
livetvAdmin.paddingHint: Default for new recordings; guides are often a few minutes off.
livetvAdmin.timeshiftHint: How far viewers can pause and rewind live TV. Kept in the transcode folder.
livetvAdmin.retentionHint: Off by default. Only deletes files the DVR recorded itself, never other media.
livetvAdmin.keepLastHint: 0 = all; a series rule can set its own number.
livetvAdmin.postProcessHint: A program run after every finished recording, without a shell (for example to cut commercials).
livetvAdmin.argsHint: Each line is passed as one argument; placeholders are replaced.
